class darq.src.datasets.MRI_DaT(subject_df, transforms=None, crop_dat=False, crop_labels=False)[source]

Bases: Dataset

PyTorch dataset for paired MRI, SynthSeg and DaTSCAN data.

Each item loads one subject/session, prepares anatomical masks from the SynthSeg labels, estimates DaT foreground masks and returns the dictionary required by the registration pipeline.

Parameters:

  • transforms (list | None)

  • crop_dat (bool)

  • crop_labels (bool)

class darq.src.models.InstanceModelClassic(image_shape, ref_v2r, flo_v2r=None, batchsize=1, device='cpu', **kwargs)[source]

Base class for voxel-grid registration models.

The class stores image geometry, affine matrices and a voxel grid. Subclasses define the actual transformation parameters and RAS-space matrix computation.

darq.src.preprocessing module

class darq.src.preprocessing.AlignLR(keys, ref_im, ref_v2r, rescaling_factor=1, w_reg=0.01, angle_factor=1.0, tx_factor=1.0, device='cpu')[source]

Bases: Transform

Estimate a left-right symmetry alignment for an image or mask.

This transform optimizes a rigid transform that makes the selected reference mask more symmetric around the left-right axis. The resulting matrices are later used to create a common template space.

Parameters:

  • keys (list)

  • ref_v2r (str)

  • rescaling_factor (float)

  • w_reg (float)

  • device (str)

Create a shared template grid for several images and masks.

darq.src.results.save_session_results(dat_orig_proxy, labels_orig_proxy, loss, tag, results_dir, force_flag=False, device='cpu')[source]

Resample the registered DaT image to MRI space and save session metrics.

Parameters:

  • dat_orig_proxy (Nifti1Image) – Original DaT NIfTI image proxy.

  • labels_orig_proxy (Nifti1Image) – Original SynthSeg label NIfTI image proxy used as MRI-space reference.

  • loss – Final registration loss value.

  • tag (str) – Subject/session identifier used in output filenames.

  • results_dir (str) – Directory where images and TSV files are written.

  • force_flag (bool) – If True, replace previous rows for the same subject/session when writing TSV files.

  • device (str) – Device to use for computations (‘cpu’ or ‘cuda’).

Returns:

None. Output images and tables are written to disk.

Return type:

None
